content.text: Lots of kids are still co-sleeping at Milo's age, and at five he can do a gradual move. Start by making his own bed the fun, familiar place during the day and at bedtime. Do the whole routine in his room, then stay with him for a few minutes while he falls asleep. Tell him you'll check on him, and after a few nights move your chair a bit farther from the bed each time. Going slowly like this usually goes better than a sudden "you sleep alone now."
